parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a live criminal statute (Art. 310(1), up to 7 years) that the 2023 report and a 2026 advocacy overview both show as current. It is applied to foreigners, and expulsions of foreign nationals occurred (2004, 2013). Detention of suspected same-sex-conduct cases in a facility with reported torture and beatings is severe if outed. State messaging labels dissidents with anti-gay epithets, and conversion therapy is reported as widespread, including as an alternative to jail. There is no anti-discrimination law and no recourse. Trans-specific facts are absent: no gender-marker, facility or trans-specific rules are documented, and the military-abuse account is unconfirmed. Enforcement evidence is dated (2003 arrests, 2013 expulsions), so it is not proof of current practice, but the structural signals (criminalisation, authoritarian detention, state hostility, no recourse) are extrapolated to a high-risk tier rather than the midpoint.
